title: Reactions in the app: the choice on a selected message, chips that toggle
test_cmd: cargo test -p crewcraft-server --test t341b_reactions && cargo test -p crewcraft-desktop-ui --test t341b_reactions_window
spec: The app agrees to FEATURE_REACTIONS. ChatSession::react and SignedInSession::react send Request::React (Unsupported without the feature; Usage for a code outside REACTIONS); SignedInSession::reactions reads RoomView::reactions. Command::React { room, target, reaction, on } goes through the worker as edit does (Failed on refusal), and the worker emits Event::Reactions (Update::Reactions) whenever who reacted with what changes, including an empty list once the last reaction goes. In the window a selected message offers the six reactions by name; choosing one sends React (taking it back when it is already yours) and clears the selection. Under a message, one chip per reaction reads 'Name N', is highlighted when it includes you, names the people on hover, and a click adds yours or takes it back; chips show in the thread pane too.
